papers.name: Roxin et al. · 2011
papers.title: On the Distribution of Firing Rates in Networks of Cortical Neurons
papers.authors: Alex Roxin, Nicolas Brunel, David Hansel, Gianluigi Mongillo, Carl van Vreeswijk

headline.zh: 放电率为什么呈长尾分布？
headline.en: Why do firing rates have a long-tailed distribution?

intro.zh: 用一篇理论与模拟论文，学习如何区分数学结论、模型存在性、数据拟合与参数效应。
intro.en: A theory and simulation paper shows how to separate a mathematical result, a model demonstration, a data fit and a parameter effect.

background.zh: 先前实验已观察到神经元平均放电率的右偏分布。本文问的是：近似对称的跨神经元平均输入，如何产生这种输出？背景观察需要追溯原始实验，不能算作本文新发现。
background.en: Earlier experiments had observed right-skewed distributions of average neuronal firing rates. This paper asks how approximately symmetric distributions of mean input across neurons can produce this output. The background observation belongs to those earlier experiments.

scope.zh: 依据发表版正文、方法和图 1–8。这里展开五条教学记录，未重跑模拟，也未穷尽全部贡献。
scope.en: Based on the published main text, methods and Figures 1–8. Five teaching records are expanded here. Simulations have not been rerun, and coverage is not exhaustive.

split.zh: “解释长尾放电率”包含不同层级的问题：在假设下能推导什么、具体网络能产生什么、与实验数据是否一致，以及参数变化怎样影响结果。这些命题需要分别判断。
split.en: “Explaining long-tailed firing rates” contains different questions: what follows from assumptions, what a network produces, whether a model fits observations, and what changes with a parameter. These propositions need separate assessments.

directions.zh: 神经动力学与网络；表征与编码
directions.en: Neural dynamics and networks; representation and coding

question.zh: 长尾放电率分布是否必须依赖长尾突触权重？
question.en: Does a long-tailed firing-rate distribution require long-tailed synaptic weights?

answer.zh: 本文的模型例子说明：在所研究的条件下，非线性传递函数可以产生右偏分布，而不必先假定长尾权重。这并不说明真实皮层没有长尾权重，也不能由分布形状识别唯一机制。
answer.en: These model examples show that, under the studied conditions, nonlinear transfer can produce a right-skewed distribution without first assuming long-tailed weights. This does not imply that cortex lacks such weights or that distribution shape identifies a unique mechanism.

remaining.zh: 尚未逐条展开：幂律指数（图 2）、噪声和膜时间常数（图 3）、平均放电率（图 4）、E/I 群体混合（图 6）。正式宣称完整提取前，需要为这些结果补齐记录。
remaining.en: Not individually expanded: power-law exponent (Fig. 2), noise and membrane time constant (Fig. 3), mean firing rate (Fig. 4), and E/I population mixtures (Fig. 6). These require records before claiming complete coverage.

relations.zh: C1 提供输入到输出的数学解释框架。C2 检查一个具体网络实现。
relations.en: C1 supplies the mathematical input-to-output framework. C2 examines a particular network implementation.

relations.zh: C2 与 C3 使用重叠的模拟证据，分别判断偏斜和拟合偏离。它们不构成独立复现。
relations.en: C2 and C3 share simulation evidence while assessing skewness and departures from a fit. They are not independent replications.

relations.zh: C4 将模型与已有数据比较。C5 检查另一组模型中的参数效应。
relations.en: C4 compares a model with existing data. C5 examines a parameter effect in another model setting.

claim.zh: 若跨神经元输入为高斯分布，且传递函数为 ν = ν₀ exp(βI)，其中 ν₀ > 0、β > 0，则输出放电率服从对数正态分布。
claim.en: If input across neurons is Gaussian and the transfer function is ν = ν₀ exp(βI), with ν₀ > 0 and β > 0, the output firing rate is lognormally distributed.

evidence.zh: 对单调传递函数进行概率密度变量变换（公式 3），再代入指数函数得到公式 6。图 1 对比线性和指数变换。
evidence.en: Transform the probability density through a monotonic transfer function (Eq. 3), then substitute the exponential to obtain Eq. 6. Figure 1 contrasts linear and exponential transfer.

unit.zh: 证据单位是带假设的推导，不存在实验样本量。
unit.en: The evidence unit is a derivation with assumptions; there is no experimental sample size.

positive.zh: 在这些假设下，输入到输出的分布关系可以解析得到。
positive.en: The input-to-output distribution follows analytically under these assumptions.

boundary.zh: 高斯输入、固定的指数传递函数。变量变换要求所考虑区间内可逆。
boundary.en: Gaussian input and a fixed exponential transfer function. The density transformation requires invertibility on the relevant range.

negative.zh: 此条是条件性推导，未单列失败实验。
negative.en: This conditional derivation does not report a separate failed experiment.

nonInference.zh: 不能反推真实皮层的传递函数唯一为指数，也不能将任意非线性都称为精确对数正态的生成机制。
nonInference.en: It does not identify an exponential as the unique cortical transfer function or make every nonlinearity a generator of an exactly lognormal distribution.

unresolved.zh: 真实输入和神经元传递函数在什么条件下满足这些假设？这是本记录标出的外推问题。
unresolved.en: When do real inputs and neuronal transfer functions meet these assumptions? This is an extrapolation question identified by this record.

lesson.zh: 把一般性的机制叙述收窄为可逐步检查的条件命题。
lesson.en: Turn a broad mechanism statement into a conditional proposition that can be checked step by step.

short.zh: 随机网络产生右偏分布

claim.zh: 在图 5 的波动驱动、异步不规则状态下，随机连接 LIF 网络产生右偏的平均放电率分布。
claim.en: In the fluctuation-driven, asynchronous irregular regime of Figure 5, a randomly connected LIF network produces a right-skewed distribution of mean firing rates.

evidence.zh: 10,000 个兴奋性与 2,500 个抑制性神经元，连接概率 0.1。图 5 对照平均输入分布、活动轨迹与输出率分布。
evidence.en: A network of 10,000 excitatory and 2,500 inhibitory neurons with connection probability 0.1. Figure 5 compares mean inputs, activity traces and firing-rate distributions.

unit.zh: 图 5D 汇总 10 个不同连接实现，各模拟 10 秒，误差条为 SD。12,500 个神经元不能当作 12,500 次独立网络重复。
unit.en: Figure 5D summarizes 10 different connectivity realizations, simulated for 10 seconds each; error bars are SD. The 12,500 neurons are not 12,500 independent network repetitions.

positive.zh: 支持该网络及参数条件下的模型内存在性。
positive.en: Supports existence within this network and parameter setting.

boundary.zh: 限定图 5 的细胞模型、随机连接、输入和状态。
boundary.en: Limited to the cell model, random connectivity, inputs and state in Figure 5.

negative.zh: 本条存在性记录未单列失败条件，分布拟合的偏离另见 C3。
negative.en: This existence record does not separately enumerate failed conditions; departures from the distributional fit appear in C3.

nonInference.zh: 不能据此断言所有皮层网络、状态或细胞类型都呈同一分布。
nonInference.en: This does not establish the same distribution for all cortical networks, states or cell types.

unresolved.zh: 尚未测试的连接结构和活动状态是否保留这一现象？
unresolved.en: Does the phenomenon persist in untested connectivity structures and activity states?

lesson.zh: 神经元数、模拟时长、网络重复次数必须分别记录。
lesson.en: Keep neuron count, simulation duration and network repetitions separate.

short.zh: 近似不等于精确对数正态

claim.zh: 图 5 的 LIF 放电率分布相对最佳拟合对数正态，在低率端偏多、高率端偏少。
claim.en: Relative to the best-fit lognormal, the LIF firing-rate distribution in Figure 5 has an excess at low rates and a deficit at high rates.

evidence.zh: 同一批模拟分布与对数正态拟合曲线的对照，以及结果段中的明确描述。
evidence.en: Comparison of the simulated distribution with the lognormal fit, explicitly described in the Results.

unit.zh: 与 C2 共享模拟证据。这里没有新增一组独立实验。
unit.en: Shares simulation evidence with C2. No additional independent experiment is introduced.

positive.zh: 可以同时支持“右偏”与“存在对数正态拟合偏离”。
positive.en: Supports both right skewness and departures from the lognormal fit.

boundary.zh: 适用于所展示的 LIF 条件。文中还讨论在特定极限下趋近对数正态。
boundary.en: Applies to the displayed LIF conditions. The paper also discusses convergence to lognormality in particular limits.

negative.zh: 精确对数正态未得到这组结果支持。原文未在这里给出拟合优度检验的 p 值，不能补造。
negative.en: Exact lognormality is not supported by this result. No goodness-of-fit p value is supplied here; none should be invented.

nonInference.zh: 不能推广为所有神经数据都不是对数正态。
nonInference.en: Does not establish that all neuronal datasets are non-lognormal.

unresolved.zh: 采样时长、静默细胞及细胞混合会怎样影响偏离的估计？这是整理者提出的后续检查问题。
unresolved.en: How would sampling duration, silent cells and cell mixtures affect estimated departures? This is a follow-up check proposed by the curator.

lesson.zh: 保留实际偏离，同时避免将图示比较改写成未做过的统计检验。
lesson.en: Preserve the observed departure without inventing a statistical test.

short.zh: 模型与已发表数据比较

claim.zh: 适当选择参数后，LIF 分布能够描述本文所比较的两组皮层放电率数据。
claim.en: With suitable parameters, LIF distributions can describe the two cortical firing-rate datasets compared in the paper.

evidence.zh: 图 7A 比较大鼠听觉皮层自发活动，图 7B 比较小鼠桶状皮层任务记录。数据来自 Hromádka 等（2008）与 O’Connor 等（2010）。
evidence.en: Figure 7A compares spontaneous activity in rat auditory cortex; Figure 7B compares task recordings in mouse barrel cortex. Data come from Hromádka et al. (2008) and O’Connor et al. (2010).

unit.zh: 图 7B 涉及 92 个神经元，不能写成 92 只动物。图 7A 的模拟误差为 2 SD，实验误差为 95% CI。
unit.en: Figure 7B concerns 92 neurons, not 92 animals. In Figure 7A, simulation error bars are 2 SD and experimental error bars are 95% CI.

positive.zh: 支持模型分布与这些资料的相容性。
positive.en: Supports compatibility between model distributions and these datasets.

boundary.zh: 图 7B 用的是无耦合 LIF 神经元的解析分布。讨论明确说明拟合未纳入静默细胞。
boundary.en: Figure 7B uses an analytical distribution for uncoupled LIF neurons. The Discussion explicitly states that silent cells were excluded from the fit.

negative.zh: 这不是原文报告的一个独立失败实验。
negative.en: This is not a separately reported failed experiment.

nonInference.zh: 不能用分布拟合来证明机制唯一、因果必要，或整套递归网络得到实验验证。
nonInference.en: A distributional fit does not establish uniqueness, causal necessity, or experimental validation of an entire recurrent network.

unresolved.zh: 不同机制能否同样拟合这些数据？
unresolved.en: Could other mechanisms fit these data equally well?

lesson.zh: 已有数据的再分析与新采集实验分开；核对每个面板实际比较的模型。
lesson.en: Separate reuse of existing data from new experiments, and check the actual model in each panel.

short.zh: 突触异质性与分布宽度

claim.zh: 在本文所测的电导网络条件下，增加突触电导分布的宽度可使放电率分布变窄。
claim.en: Under the tested conductance-network conditions, increasing the spread of synaptic conductances can narrow the firing-rate distribution.

evidence.zh: 在保持平均电导的设置下改变对数电导分布的标准差 σg；图 8D 对照模拟分布和拟合。
evidence.en: Vary the standard deviation σg of log conductance while holding mean conductance fixed; Figure 8D compares simulated distributions and fits.

unit.zh: 参数条件的模拟比较。该图没有给出可直接当作重复数的独立网络 n。
unit.en: A simulation comparison across parameter settings. The figure does not supply an independent-network n that can be used as a replicate count.

positive.zh: 在所测范围内得到分布变窄这一参数效应。
positive.en: Finds narrowing across the tested range.

boundary.zh: 指定电导模型、平均电导控制与输入，原文报告检查至 σg = 0.8。
boundary.en: Specific conductance model, mean-conductance control and inputs; the paper reports testing up to σg = 0.8.

negative.zh: 未单列失败结果，不能将反直觉结果自动称为负结果。
negative.en: No separate failed result is listed; a counterintuitive result is not automatically a negative result.

nonInference.zh: 不能写成“异质性总会减少神经活动差异”。
nonInference.en: Does not imply that heterogeneity always reduces variation in neural activity.

unresolved.zh: 改变均值控制或连接结构后是否仍成立？
unresolved.en: Does this persist with different mean controls or connectivity?

lesson.zh: 参数比较要保留固定量和变化量，不能只抄趋势。
lesson.en: Preserve what was held fixed and what was varied, rather than copying only the trend.

papers.name: Branco, Clark & Häusser · 2010
papers.title: Dendritic Discrimination of Temporal Input Sequences in Cortical Neurons
papers.authors: Tiago Branco, Beverley A. Clark, Michael Häusser

headline.zh: 一根树突能区分输入顺序吗？
headline.en: Can a dendrite distinguish input order?

intro.zh: 用 Häusser 参与的较早经典实验工作，学习如何拆开电压、放电、钙信号和药理干预的证据。
intro.en: An earlier experimental study coauthored by Häusser illustrates how to separate evidence from voltage, spiking, calcium signals and pharmacological intervention.

background.zh: 先前理论提出树突可能区分突触激活方向。本文通过精确控制同一组位点的刺激顺序，检验皮层锥体细胞是否具有这种敏感性。历史预测属于背景，具体测量才是本篇贡献。
background.en: Earlier theory proposed that dendrites could distinguish directions of synaptic activation. This study controls the order of stimulation at the same sites to test sensitivity in cortical pyramidal neurons. Historical predictions are background; the measurements are this paper’s contribution.

scope.zh: 依据作者实验室提供的发表版正文和主图 1–4。补充材料未在本示例中完整核对；依赖补充材料的模型解释和跨细胞类型推广列为后续提取任务。未复现实验。
scope.en: Based on the published main text and Figures 1–4 supplied by the author’s lab. Supplementary materials have not been fully checked for this example; model explanations and generalization across cell types that depend on them remain follow-up extraction tasks. Experiments have not been replicated.

split.zh: “树突区分序列”可能指胞体电压不同、放电概率不同或局部钙信号不同。药物干预又回答另一个问题：NMDA 受体对这种差异有什么作用？不同读出和干预分别建档。
split.en: “Dendrites discriminate sequences” can mean different somatic voltages, spike probabilities or local calcium signals. Drug intervention asks a further question about the role of NMDA receptors. Each readout and intervention gets its own record.

directions.zh: 细胞机制；表征与编码；测量与干预
directions.en: Cellular mechanisms; representation and coding; measurement and intervention

question.zh: 改变同一组输入的顺序，是否足以改变神经元输出？
question.en: Can changing the order of the same inputs change neuronal output?

answer.zh: 在本文受控刺激条件下可以：胞体 EPSP、放电概率和局部钙信号均有相关证据，NMDA 阻断会显著减弱相应效应。这仍不能回答动物在自然行为中是否必需依靠这一计算。
answer.en: Under the controlled stimulation conditions here, yes: somatic EPSPs, spike probability and local calcium signals provide relevant evidence, and NMDA blockade strongly reduces related effects. This does not establish whether animals require this computation during natural behavior.

remaining.zh: 尚未完整提取：单分支随机序列的比较（图 4A–D）、多通路电刺激（图 4G–H）、补充材料中的阻抗梯度机制模型、跨形态推广、抑制和时间抖动。不能把正文对补充结果的概述标成已经完整复核。
remaining.en: Not fully extracted: random sequences on one branch (Fig. 4A–D), multi-pathway electrical stimulation (Fig. 4G–H), and supplementary analyses of impedance gradients, morphology, inhibition and timing jitter. A main-text summary of supplementary findings is not a full verification of those findings.

relations.zh: C1、C2、C3 分别记录电压、放电和钙读出；并非三次独立复现。
relations.en: C1, C2 and C3 record voltage, spike and calcium readouts; they are not three independent replications.

relations.zh: C4 为 C1 的 NMDA 依赖性提供干预证据，但不单独证明完整机制模型。
relations.en: C4 provides intervention evidence for NMDA dependence of C1, without independently proving the full mechanistic model.

relations.zh: C5 检查空间上分散的输入，不应自动推广为所有序列均可识别。
relations.en: C5 examines spatially distributed inputs; it does not establish discrimination of every sequence.

claim.zh: 在所测皮层锥体细胞的单条树突上，朝向胞体的输入序列（IN）比反向序列（OUT）产生更大的胞体 EPSP。
claim.en: On the tested single dendrites of cortical pyramidal neurons, sequences toward the soma (IN) produce larger somatic EPSPs than the reverse (OUT).

evidence.zh: 两光子谷氨酸解笼按相反顺序刺激相同树突棘位点。作者报告在方向选择性最佳速度下，IN 响应比 OUT 大 31 ± 4%，峰值差 2.8 ± 0.4 mV。
evidence.en: Two-photon glutamate uncaging stimulates the same spine sites in opposite orders. At the optimal velocity for directional selectivity, the authors report a 31 ± 4% larger IN response and a peak difference of 2.8 ± 0.4 mV.

unit.zh: 正文记作 n = 20 observations；不擅自改成 20 只动物或 20 个独立实验。图 1G–H 的速度曲线另标 n = 15。
unit.en: The text gives n = 20 observations; do not relabel these as 20 animals or independent experiments. The velocity curves in Fig. 1G–H separately report n = 15.

positive.zh: 在受控位点和时序条件下，输入顺序可改变电压读出。
positive.en: Input order changes the voltage readout under controlled site and timing conditions.

boundary.zh: 特定皮层层次、树突分支、解笼位点与输入速度。最佳速度的比较不是所有速度的统一效应。
boundary.en: Specific cortical layer, branches, uncaging sites and velocities. A comparison at optimal velocity is not a uniform effect at every velocity.

negative.zh: 本条未单列失败实验；药理削弱另见 C4。
negative.en: No separate failed experiment is listed here; pharmacological attenuation is recorded in C4.

nonInference.zh: 不能由 EPSP 不同直接推出动物行为分类准确率。
nonInference.en: Different EPSPs do not directly establish behavioral classification accuracy.

unresolved.zh: 自然输入统计和行为状态下，这种读出贡献多大？这是整理者标出的外推问题。
unresolved.en: How much does this readout contribute with natural inputs and behavioral states? This is an extrapolation question identified by the curator.

lesson.zh: 保留刺激控制与测量指标，准确转录原文对 n 的称呼。
lesson.en: Preserve stimulus controls and the measurement, and retain the source’s wording for n.

claim.zh: 在所测刺激条件下，IN 序列比 OUT 序列更容易诱发动作电位输出。
claim.en: Under the tested stimulation conditions, IN sequences elicit action-potential output more readily than OUT sequences.

evidence.zh: 比较相反方向序列的放电概率，图 1I–K 展示代表性反应和汇总结果，原文报告 P = 0.0013。
evidence.en: Compare spike probability for opposite-direction sequences. Figure 1I–K shows responses and population results; the text reports P = 0.0013.

unit.zh: 原文报告 n = 7。重复刺激次数不能视为独立细胞或动物数。
unit.en: The source reports n = 7. Repeated stimulation trials must not be treated as independent cells or animals.

positive.zh: 序列敏感性能够到达动作电位输出层面。
positive.en: Sequence sensitivity can reach action-potential output.

boundary.zh: 该结果针对已测试的序列、速度与放电条件。
boundary.en: Applies to the tested sequences, velocities and firing conditions.

negative.zh: 未报告所有序列均可完全分类。此缺失不等于分类实验失败。
negative.en: Perfect classification of every sequence is not reported; its absence is not a failed classification experiment.

nonInference.zh: 不能把电压效应直接当成放电效应的样本，本条有自己的读出与 n。
nonInference.en: Voltage observations are not automatically spike-output observations; this record has its own readout and n.

unresolved.zh: 在自然背景活动下，输出区分度如何变化？
unresolved.en: How does output discriminability change with natural background activity?

lesson.zh: 即使同在一张图内，不同输出变量也可以需要独立 claim。
lesson.en: Different output variables can require separate claims even within one figure.

short.zh: 钙信号也有方向敏感性

claim.zh: 在所测树突中，局部钙信号对输入方向和速度敏感，IN 的峰值高于 OUT。
claim.en: In the tested dendrites, local calcium signals depend on input direction and velocity, with higher peaks for IN than OUT.

evidence.zh: 将解笼刺激与树突钙成像结合。作者报告 IN 峰值较 OUT 增加 48 ± 13%，P = 0.0047。
evidence.en: Combine uncaging with dendritic calcium imaging. The authors report a 48 ± 13% higher IN peak, P = 0.0047.

unit.zh: 该比较正文记为 n = 6；图 2F 的空间分布单独标 n = 5 cells，不混用。
unit.en: The comparison reports n = 6; the spatial profile in Fig. 2F separately reports n = 5 cells. Keep these distinct.

positive.zh: 输入顺序的差异可在局部化学信号中读出。
positive.en: Input-order differences are also observable in a local chemical signal.

boundary.zh: 限于该成像、刺激和细胞条件，图中归一化须按图注理解。
boundary.en: Limited to these imaging, stimulation and cell conditions; normalization follows the figure legend.

negative.zh: 本条没有直接检验突触可塑性是否发生。
negative.en: This record does not directly test whether synaptic plasticity occurs.

nonInference.zh: 钙信号不同不等于长期可塑性已经被诱导。
nonInference.en: Different calcium signals do not establish induction of long-term plasticity.

unresolved.zh: 这种差异是否及如何转化为可塑性？原文将其作为可能性讨论。
unresolved.en: Whether and how the difference produces plasticity is discussed in the paper as a possibility.

lesson.zh: 测到可能触发机制的信号，不等于已经测到下游机制结果。
lesson.en: Measuring a potentially triggering signal is distinct from measuring its downstream outcome.

claim.zh: 在该实验协议中，D-AP5 阻断 NMDA 受体后，EPSP 超线性和强方向敏感性明显减弱。
claim.en: In this protocol, blocking NMDA receptors with D-AP5 strongly reduces EPSP supralinearity and robust direction sensitivity.

evidence.zh: 阻断后的响应约为线性和的 103 ± 3%（n = 8）；IN/OUT 峰差降至 0.4 ± 0.4 mV，较对照显著减小（P = 0.0011）。
evidence.en: After blockade, responses are about 103 ± 3% of the linear sum (n = 8); the IN/OUT peak difference falls to 0.4 ± 0.4 mV, significantly below control (P = 0.0011).

unit.zh: 药理条件下的细胞响应及组间/条件比较。每个指标沿用原文对应统计，不为全部面板套一个 n。
unit.en: Cell responses under pharmacological conditions and the reported comparisons. Use the statistic for each measure rather than assigning one n to every panel.

positive.zh: 提供此协议中 NMDA 受体参与强非线性和序列敏感性的干预证据。
positive.en: Provides intervention evidence for NMDA receptor involvement in strong nonlinearity and sequence sensitivity in this protocol.

boundary.zh: 限定 D-AP5 操作、刺激和受测细胞。干预效应不等于所有机制细节都被独立识别。
boundary.en: Limited to the D-AP5 manipulation, stimulation and tested cells. The intervention does not independently identify every mechanistic detail.

negative.zh: 阻断条件未保留对照中的强超线性。与线性和比较 P = 0.336，不能把“不显著”写成已经证明严格相等。
negative.en: The strong control supralinearity is not retained under blockade. P = 0.336 against the linear sum does not prove exact equality.

nonInference.zh: 不应写成 NMDA 是所有神经元序列处理的唯一机制，或所有差异严格降为零。
nonInference.en: Does not establish NMDA as the sole mechanism of sequence processing in all neurons, or that every difference becomes exactly zero.

unresolved.zh: 阻抗梯度与受体非线性的完整解释还依赖补充模型，需另行核对。
unresolved.en: The full account involving impedance gradients and receptor nonlinearity also relies on supplementary models requiring separate inspection.

lesson.zh: 把干预支持的局部依赖性与全机制唯一性分开，也保留残余效应。
lesson.en: Separate dependence under intervention from mechanistic uniqueness, and retain residual effects.

short.zh: 分散输入仍可产生序列差异

claim.zh: 在多个树突上分散激活位点时，所测试的两种序列仍产生不同的胞体 EPSP。
claim.en: With activation sites distributed across dendrites, the tested sequences still produce different somatic EPSPs.

evidence.zh: 图 4E–F 改变同组分散位点的激活次序。正文报告平均峰差 3.3 ± 0.8 mV（P = 0.0065），超极化后差异降至 0.58 ± 0.2 mV。
evidence.en: Figure 4E–F changes activation order at the same distributed sites. The text reports a mean peak difference of 3.3 ± 0.8 mV (P = 0.0065), reduced to 0.58 ± 0.2 mV with hyperpolarization.

unit.zh: 正文报告 n = 9。它与图 4A–D 单分支随机序列的 n = 7 是不同比较。
unit.en: The text reports n = 9. This differs from the n = 7 comparison of random single-branch sequences in Fig. 4A–D.

positive.zh: 该受测空间条件下，序列敏感性不限于同一分支上的顺向与逆向刺激。
positive.en: In the tested spatial setting, sequence sensitivity extends beyond inward and outward activation on one branch.

boundary.zh: 只覆盖所测空间排列、序列与电位。补充图的更多模拟未在本例完整核对。
boundary.en: Covers the tested spatial arrangements, sequences and voltages. Additional supplementary simulations were not fully checked in this example.

negative.zh: 超极化后差异明显减小；该结果不能描述成所有状态下同样稳健。
negative.en: Differences are markedly reduced with hyperpolarization; the result is not equally robust across all states.

nonInference.zh: 不能推导对任意序列、任意空间分布或行为任务都有高分类率。
nonInference.en: Does not establish high classification accuracy for arbitrary sequences, spatial distributions or behavioral tasks.

unresolved.zh: 自然输入、背景抑制与状态变化对这一读出的影响仍需专门检验。
unresolved.en: Effects of natural input, background inhibition and changing state require dedicated tests.

lesson.zh: 推广性主张必须写明实际增加了哪一个条件，以及哪些条件仍未覆盖。
lesson.en: A generalization claim must specify the added condition and the conditions still untested.
